digest.component_or_area: RP-04 secrets and authentication architecture research
propositions: Rebar must support credential injection for nine external providers across eight deployment environments without a universal secret broker or weakening SDK-native refresh and rotation.
Static credentials rotate only via restart/redeploy; runtime hot-reload of secrets is not supported and requires external platform restart/task replacement.

Operation snapshots must remain non-secret and unable to contain credential carriers; only provider-specific non-serializable static-auth containers at adapter boundaries may hold unavoidable static values.

Deployment resolves external secret stores (SSM, vaults, etc.) before process startup and supplies credentials as either a file path or environment variable; Rebar consumes but does not retrieve or rotate secrets.

Subprocess children inherit the ambient environment for compatibility; Rebar overlays static credentials only onto their owning child and removes exact sibling-secret names to prevent accidental credential propagation.
